request: Preserve H1A v1: HTTP Basic; only grant_type=client_credentials in body. No caller/audience/scope selector; one audience derived from authenticated client_id by the server.
credentials: Separate CSPRNG secrets for every client profile, including rotation slots. Retain existing H1A rotation/cutoff checks; reject reuse across any profiles. Profile IDs authenticate clients; caller is the canonical workload fixed by this policy, not necessarily the client_id.
isolation: A token for one audience or caller never authenticates another purpose. Verify exact string audience, service type, signature, issuer, kid, expiry and canonical caller. Gateway current profile remains unchanged; delegated catalog user-api is separate from H2 user-api.
activation: Candidate policy only. Missing/disabled new profile fails closed; no fallback to another credential or audience. Published old profiles remain unchanged. No new consumer, PWA or runtime is admitted.
privacy: Never version real secrets, tokens or authentication payloads. Publish only client/profile identifiers and policy; logs contain no credential values.
